[Trait] COMPUTER CLASSES, DUH At the beginning of the game place adjacent either the Batcycle or Batwing bystander. When that bystander is KO'd, after actions resolve place the other bystander adjacent.
[Trait] THE DARK KNIGHT RETURNS: GET SEEN AND YOU'RE FIRED Powers: Shape Change, Perplex When Robin occupies clear terrain, she can use Shape Change. When she occupies hindering terrain, she can use Perplex but only to target another character occupying hindering terrain.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Trait] THE DARK KNIGHT RETURNS: NOT HIDING ANYMORE Powers: Sidestep When Green Arrow occupies clear terrain, he can use Sidestep and opposing characters can't draw lines of fire to him unless they are within three squares of him or he has 2 action tokens.
[Trait] ...IT STILL HURTS WHEN IT'S COLD Green Arrow can't make range attacks when he has 1 action token.
[Attack] KRYPTONITE ARROWS When Green Arrow hits with a ranged attack, the hit target can't use defense powers until your next turn. If the hit target has the Kryptonian keyword also give it an action token.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Trait] A SYMBOL OF AUTHORITY... AND OBEDIENCE At the beginning of your turn, you may roll a d6. [d:5]-[d:6]: Until your next turn, Superman has PROTECTED: Outwit, opposing Probability Control. [d:3]-[d:4]: You may remove an action token from him. [d:1]: He has IMMOBILE until your next turn.
[Speed] WE MUST NOT REMIND THEM THAT GIANTS WALK THE EARTH Powers: Charge, Stealth Superman can use Charge and Stealth. If Superman began the turn occupying hindering terrain, don't halve his speed value when using Charge this turn.
[Damage] SOLAR POWER STORED BY A SUFFERING WORLD Give Superman a free action when he occupies printed outdoor hindering terrain and roll a d6. Heal him of half the result and put a Scoured marker in that square. Squares with Scoured markers in them are considered clear terrain instead of hindering terrain for the rest of the game.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Speed] MAGNETIC SKIN Powers: Plasticity, Sidestep The Skyscraper Wonder Woman can use Plasticity and Sidestep. When an adjacent opposing character fails to break away, after actions resolve give it an action token. If you can't, deal it 1 unavoidable damage.
[Attack] THE TRIAL OF ICE When The Skyscraper Wonder Woman hits an opposing character, after actions resolve choose one: give that character an action token; -or- place that character in any square within 5 squares of The Skyscraper Wonder Woman that's closer to your starting area than its current square.
[Defense] COLOSSAL RETALIATION: BURY YOU IN SAND Give The Skyscraper Wonder Woman a free action if no other Colossal Retaliation power has been activated this turn and choose an opposing character that attacked The Skyscraper Wonder Woman or damaged a friendly character since your last turn. Place The Skyscraper Wonder Woman such that it can make a close attack targeting the chosen character and also target all other characters within 2 squares of the target. Hit characters are each dealt 3 damage instead of normal damage and can't move or be placed or make range attacks during their next turns.
[Damage] COLOSSAL INDIFFERENCE Powers: Stop, Toughness STOP. The Skyscraper Wonder Woman can use Toughness. If The Skyscraper Wonder Woman began the game on the 15-point starting line, she can't attack smaller characters except via Colossal Retaliation.
